objective: Preregister 20 candidates (E base+7, S base+9, C 2) optimizing the two batch-2 candidates the owner liked on 2026-09-28, judged via scripts/screen_batch.py against the owner's literal three-part per-family replacement rule. No backtest run yet.

parameters.freq: D (calendar-anchored, single version per candidate; no offset sweep)

family_base.description: E0 (batch-2's EOM_REVERSAL_SPY) and S0 (batch-2's FRONT_RUN_SECTOR_TOP2), each variant judged against its own family's base only.

s3_incumbent_reference.description: Reported for context (correlation, anchor/stress Sharpe) on every candidate; not used to select.

per_family: (b) 2026 contaminated-window Sharpe not below base by more than 0.10 (guard)
adoption_rule.pass_requires: ALL THREE conditions, for the highest-select-Sharpe qualifying variant
adoption_rule.multiple_comparisons: 20 candidates across 3 families; DSR computed per family with trial_count = that family's variant count including base (E=8, S=10, C=2)
adoption_rule.fallback_if_none_pass: family base stands unchanged; every variant recorded with its verdict, none silently dropped
adoption_rule.g3_placebo: see candidate-manifest.json's g3_not_applicable_reason -- the three-part replacement rule plus per-family DSR serves this role for a bounded, source-grounded variant search
